name: Sensescape VR
summary:
A virtual world for neuro-divergent people offering a safe space for those with specialized sensory needs. It features a room just like a real sensory room with bubble columns and interactive elements to generate stimulation. The app also includes two (2) areas for relaxation and meditation.

This app does not require the use of controllers. Users interact directly with their hands with simple interaction such as pinching, making a fist, thumb up and thumb down.
